title: Oven Roasted Portuguese Chicken Roast
description: A peppery and crunchy Portuguese dish featuring dark brown sugar, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is egg-free-friendly and cooked to perfection in an iron teppan vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the dark brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt.
Rinse the chicken thighs and pat them dry with paper towels.
Brush the chicken thighs with olive oil and sprinkle the sugar and spice mixture evenly over both sides of the chicken.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the chicken thighs.
Place the chicken thighs in the iron teppan vessel and put it in the oven.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is crispy.
Remove the chicken from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Let the chicken rest for 10 minutes before serving.
